hooks.comment: Session-tree injection: stdout becomes hookSpecificOutput.additionalContext, which the hooks-claude-code bridge merges and injects as a session-start user message. Status goes to stderr (never the envelope). Empty doc = nothing printed = no injection.

First-turn injection, once per session lifetime: the session-tree envelope rides the first pre-step (same moment the host injects AGENTS.md reminders). Emits nothing when already delivered or no history exists. The SessionStart inject above stays as a best-effort fast path; the once-marker makes double delivery impossible.
